title: Sutando config
description: Contract for sutando.config.json and sutando.config.local.json. The loader (src/sutando_config.{py,ts}) deep-merges the two and expands ${REPO_DIR} in every string value before validating against this schema. Keys whose name starts with `_` are stripped before validation (comment convention used in the .example file).

core.description: Persistent CLI runtime used for the Sutando core task executor.

expected_branch.description: Branch the live checkout is expected to be on; health-check's live-checkout-branch probe warns on drift. Set on hosts intentionally pinned to a non-main branch (e.g. dual-run pinned nodes). SUTANDO_EXPECTED_BRANCH env var overrides per-invocation.

checkout_behind_warn.description: Commits behind origin/<expected_branch> before health-check's live-checkout-branch probe warns that the checkout is stale. Being ON the right branch is only half of being current — a checkout can sit on main and still run weeks-old code. Deliberately not 1: main moves several times a day, so warning on any delta trains the reader to ignore the probe. Invalid values (non-integer, zero, negative) fall back to 10 rather than crashing the health check or warning on a current checkout. No env-var override.

sandbox.description: Read-only sandbox that answers non-owner (team/other) Discord tasks. Codex by default. Set gemini on an install without Codex CLI, which needs the gemini CLI on PATH and GEMINI_API_KEY (or other gemini auth) in .env. SUTANDO_SANDBOX_RUNTIME env var overrides per-invocation.

workspace.description: Workspace location config. Resolution order: sutando.config.local.json > sutando.config.json > baked-in default ${REPO_DIR}/workspace. $SUTANDO_WORKSPACE is NOT honored (removed in v0.8); setting it only warns.

path.description: Absolute or ${REPO_DIR}-relative path to the workspace directory. The loader expands ${REPO_DIR} to the directory containing this file (== git toplevel for a sane checkout).

claude_sutando_config_dir.description: Where the Sutando-scoped Claude Code config lives — set via the `claude-sutando` shell function as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Constrained to a workspace sub-folder so the M2 vault sync engine can include it via a single workspace-relative glob; if the path escapes the workspace, sync coherence breaks.

subdir.description: Sub-folder of <workspace> for CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. MUST be a relative sub-path of the workspace — absolute paths (leading `/`) and `..` parent-directory escapes are rejected. The loader additionally asserts the resolved final path stays under workspace (defense in depth).

core_config_dirs.description: Per-runtime CLI state/config directories. Arrays replace wholesale in local config.

value.description: Supports ${REPO_DIR}, ${WORKSPACE_DIR}, and a leading ~. synced=true values must resolve under the workspace.

vault.description: Vault (durable knowledge sync) config. Off by default; opt-in by setting enabled=true in sutando.config.local.json plus a remote_url. The sync engine (M2) reads sync.include + sync.exclude to decide what flows to the remote.

enabled.description: Master switch for vault sync. When false, no remote pushes regardless of other vault settings.

remote_url.description: URL of the remote git repo that holds the synced workspace subset. Empty string means unconfigured.

sync.description: What to sync. Include is an allowlist of paths relative to the workspace root; exclude carves out machine-local noise from within included paths. include/exclude arrays REPLACE on merge (not unioned) — overriding either in .local.json wipes the defaults for that array. Use exclude_extra to ADD a carve-out while keeping the shipped ones.

include.description: Workspace-relative paths to sync. Trailing slash convention indicates a directory.

exclude.description: Workspace-relative paths to skip during sync. Glob patterns supported (e.g. '*.heartbeat').

exclude_extra.description: Workspace-relative paths APPENDED to exclude rather than replacing it. Shipped denies stay first (gitignore is last-match-wins) and duplicates are dropped. There is no include_extra: include is the whitelist, and unioning it would widen what the vault carries.

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between sync runs when sync is enabled. Minimum 60 to avoid hammering the remote.

down_bridge_action.description: What --fix does with a configured-but-not-running channel bridge. `restart`: restart it (only from a canonical checkout — clean + on main) and alert; if the checkout guard fails, downgrade to alert-only. `alert` (the default): never restart, only alert. `off`: do nothing. Overridable via $SUTANDO_DOWN_BRIDGE_ACTION. See resolve_down_bridge_action() in src/sutando_config.py.

bridges.description: Bridge-wide toggles shared by the Discord/Telegram/Slack bridges.

progress_stream.description: Emit in-channel '⏳ working… (Ns)' progress placeholders while a task runs.

discord_post_gate.description: Discord post-gate policy resolved by src/channels/discord/post_gate.py for every Discord sender. Either one path applied to every channel, or a {channel_id: path} map. Unset: ungated. A configured path that fails to load refuses sends (fail-closed). Env override: $SUTANDO_DISCORD_POST_GATE.

oneOf.description: Path to a Python file exporting validate(channel_id, payload). Applied to every channel. Blank is the legacy UNCONFIGURED form: the resolver strips and treats it as unset, so the schema must not reject it.

Per-channel policy files. `*` is REQUIRED and is the fallback for any channel not listed: without it an unlisted channel would send unvalidated, so the resolver refuses the whole mapping. An entry with a null/blank path refuses that one channel.

propertyNames.description: Channel ids carry no surrounding whitespace. The resolver strips keys; an untrimmed one would route that channel to `*` instead of its own policy.

*.description: Fallback policy file for every channel not named above.

additionalProperties.description: Policy file for this channel id.

migrate.description: Per-clone migration hints consumed by scripts/sutando-config.sh (migrate-stale-hosts, migrate-skip-skills).

stale_hosts.description: Per-clone machine-<host> dirs treated as stale during migration.

skip_skills.description: Host-only skill names excluded from the migration sweep.

stand.description: This instance's `Stand:` commit-trailer value (e.g. "Echo Act IV Mini"). Per-clone identity, so it belongs in sutando.config.local.json rather than the tracked default config. Read by scripts/sutando-config.sh stand to tell co-located Sutando instances apart, since both commit under the owner's GH-mapped email so --author cannot separate them.

env.description: Non-secret config values mirroring the flat env-var namespace (issue #1724). Read by config_get(); secrets stay in .env / vault.
